name: @tristimb/video-carousel
description: A custom element that autoplays a list of clips through one <dotted-grid> halftone, with a date ruler that doubles as a scrubber.
author: Tristan Timblin

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css
